# fct_itineraries_ai_extractions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_itineraries_ai_extractions` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for AI-powered itinerary extraction tasks to understand workflow status, processing steps, and cost/latency metrics. Each row represents an extraction task. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `task_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each AI extraction task, also serves as the workflow run ID. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The User ID of the Advisor who owns the trip associated with this extraction. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `cloudinary_url` | URL to the PDF file stored in Cloudinary that was processed for extraction. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `extraction_cost_usd` | Total cost in USD for AI processing across all extraction steps. Includes costs for Claude, ChatGPT, & Gemini API calls. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `extraction_first_step_at` | Timestamp of when the first extraction step began processing. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `extraction_last_step_at` | Timestamp of when the final extraction step completed. Used to calculate total latency. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `extraction_steps_completed` | Count of distinct extraction steps that were completed (e.g., extract_text, verify_page_blocks, image_mapping, image_mapping_verification). Maximum of 4 steps. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `extract_text_at` | Timestamp of when the 'extract_text' step (initial PDF text extraction) was executed. Null if step not reached. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `failure_reason` | Detailed error message or cancellation reason when the workflow fails or is canceled. Null if workflow succeeded. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `failure_type` | Type of workflow failure - either 'workflow_failure' for system errors or 'workflow_canceled' for user cancellations. Null if workflow succeeded. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_extract_text` | True/False flag indicating whether the 'extract_text' step (initial PDF text extraction) was completed. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `has_image_mapping` | True/False flag indicating whether the 'image_mapping' step (matching images to text blocks) was completed. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `has_image_mapping_verification` | True/False flag indicating whether the 'image_mapping_verification' step (validating image mappings) was completed. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `has_verify_page_blocks` | True/False flag indicating whether the 'verify_page_blocks' step (validating extracted page structure) was completed. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `image_mapping_at` | Timestamp of when the 'image_mapping' step (matching images to text blocks) was executed. Null if step not reached. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `image_mapping_verification_at` | Timestamp of when the 'image_mapping_verification' step (validating image mappings) was executed. Null if step not reached. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `itinerary_id` | Foreign Key. The base itinerary ID that links to other itinerary tables (itinerary_base_id from itineraries table). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `itinerary_version_id` | Foreign Key. The specific version ID of the itinerary created by this extraction workflow. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `latency_minutes` | Total processing time in minutes from first extraction step to last extraction step completion. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `status` | Current status of the workflow run (e.g., 'completed', 'failed', 'running', 'canceled'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `type` | Type of AI ingestion (e.g. create or append). >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `trip_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the Trip record associated with this extraction. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `verify_page_blocks_at` | Timestamp of when the 'verify_page_blocks' step (validating extracted page structure) was executed. Null if step not reached. >> SOURCE - Portal AI |
| `workflow_created_at` | When the workflow run was first initiated by the system. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `workflow_updated_at` | When the workflow run was last updated with status changes or new processing steps. >> SOURCE - Portal |
